info.title: APInteract Proxy API
info.summary: Public contract for the APInteract proxy component.
info.description: This specification is the canonical source of truth for the APInteract proxy component API used by the backend.

servers.description: Standalone proxy deployment. Remote proxy communication must use TLS.

tags.name: Proxy service
tags.description: Service health and authenticated capability discovery.

tags.name: Proxy executions
tags.description: Control-plane operations and data-plane streams used to execute an HTTP request.

x-apinteract-authorization.principalDefinition: A configured backend instance authorized to use the proxy. It is distinct from an APInteract application user.

x-apinteract-idempotency.comparison: JSON object member order is ignored; array order and all scalar values are significant.
x-apinteract-idempotency.retention: Until the associated execution is released or expires.
x-apinteract-idempotency.concurrency: Concurrent creation requests with one key resolve to exactly one execution.

x-apinteract-http-semantics.requestTarget: Semantic valid HTTP/1.1 derived from the final URL.
x-apinteract-http-semantics.defaultUserAgent: When no User-Agent field is supplied, the proxy sends apinteract-proxy/{componentVersion}. A caller-supplied User-Agent is preserved.
x-apinteract-http-semantics.responseBodyRepresentation: HTTP transfer coding removed; content encoding preserved.

x-apinteract-target-policy.resolution: The proxy resolves every target hostname, validates every candidate address, and pins one approved address into the connection while retaining the original hostname for Host and TLS verification.
x-apinteract-target-policy.dnsRebinding: All returned A and AAAA addresses must pass policy. The HTTP client cannot perform a second unvalidated resolution.

get.description: Returns only readiness and version information suitable for container and service health checks. It does not expose configuration, limits, or principal information.

200.description: The proxy is ready to accept control-plane requests.

503.description: The process is running but the proxy is not ready.

get.summary: Get proxy capabilities and principal limits
get.description: Returns protocol support and effective limits for the authenticated backend principal. The backend must verify API and frame compatibility before creating executions.

post.description: Creates a transient execution owned by the authenticated backend principal. Ownership is derived exclusively from the bearer token and cannot be supplied or changed by the client. Idempotency keys are scoped to the principal and retained until the execution is released or expires.

201.description: Execution session created, or the original creation result replayed for the same principal, idempotency key, and request descriptor.

Location.description: Relative or absolute URL of the created execution.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: True when this response replays an execution created by an earlier request with the same idempotency key.

get.description: Returns current control-plane state for an execution owned by the authenticated principal. A missing execution and an execution owned by another principal both return 404.

delete.description: Acknowledges that the backend has persisted or discarded the result and releases the execution, its response cache, and its idempotency-key mapping. Active executions cannot be released and must be cancelled first.

204.description: The terminal execution and its transient data were released.

put.description: Streams the target request payload as unmodified bytes. This operation is valid only for an execution created with body mode `stream` and while that execution is accepting an upload. The authenticated principal must own the execution. The protocol content type does not replace or imply the target request's Content-Type header. Request upload resume is not supported in framing version 1; an interrupted upload fails the execution.

204.description: The complete request body was accepted.

get.description: Opens the response data plane for an execution owned by the authenticated principal. Only one response reader may be active for an execution. The proxy returns a framed binary stream and may send heartbeat frames while waiting for the target. A RESPONSE_HEAD frame announces the target response before any BODY frame. The outer HTTP status describes this proxy operation; every valid target HTTP status, including 4xx and 5xx, is carried in RESPONSE_HEAD and completes normally unless a separate network or protocol failure occurs. Cached frames remain available until the terminal execution is released or expires.

200.description: Framed target response stream. A terminal COMPLETE or ERROR frame is required; connection closure alone does not indicate successful completion.

protocolRules: Every frame, including HEARTBEAT, consumes one sequence number.
Sequence starts at zero, increments by one, and must not wrap.
Flags and reserved fields must be zero.
Unknown frame types, nonzero flags, invalid sequence values, oversized payloads, invalid JSON, and schema-invalid JSON are fatal protocol errors.
A receiver must reject an oversized payload length before allocating payload storage.
RESPONSE_HEAD must precede BODY and may occur only once.
TRAILERS may occur only after all BODY frames and before COMPLETE.
Exactly one COMPLETE or ERROR terminal frame is required.
No frames may follow a terminal frame, and the stream must end after it.
End of stream before a terminal frame is proxy_stream_incomplete.
Replayed streams preserve original frame sequence numbers.

headerFields.name: sequence
headerFields.description: Starts at zero and increments by one for every frame.

headerFields.name: payloadLength
headerFields.description: Number of payload bytes immediately following the header.

frameTypes.name: RESPONSE_HEAD
frameTypes.cardinality: exactly once before the first BODY frame when a target response is received

frameTypes.name: BODY
frameTypes.cardinality: zero or more after RESPONSE_HEAD and before a terminal frame

frameTypes.name: TRAILERS
frameTypes.cardinality: zero or one after all BODY frames and before COMPLETE

frameTypes.name: COMPLETE
frameTypes.cardinality: exactly one terminal frame on success

frameTypes.name: ERROR
frameTypes.cardinality: exactly one terminal frame on failure

frameTypes.name: HEARTBEAT
frameTypes.cardinality: zero or more before a terminal frame

post.description: Requests best-effort cancellation of request upload, target communication, response streaming, and transient caching for an execution owned by the authenticated principal. Cancellation cannot guarantee that the target did not already process some or all of the request. Repeated cancellation requests are idempotent and return the current session state.

200.description: The execution was already terminal and its state was unchanged.

202.description: Cancellation was accepted or had already been requested.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token mapped by proxy configuration to a stable backend principal. Tokens must be sent only over TLS. Execution ownership is associated with the configured principal identifier, not with the literal token value or an APInteract application user.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque caller-generated key scoped to the authenticated principal. Concurrent or repeated creation requests with the same key and identical descriptor resolve to one execution. Reuse with different content returns 409.

ExecutionId.name: executionId
ExecutionId.description: Opaque identifier of a transient proxy execution.

AfterSequence.name: afterSequence
AfterSequence.description: Resume after this previously received frame sequence. When omitted, the stream starts or replays from sequence zero.

BadRequest.description: The request does not satisfy the proxy protocol.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

ExecutionNotFound.description: The execution does not exist or is owned by another authenticated principal.

ExecutionStateConflict.description: The operation is not valid in the execution's current state.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The idempotency key was previously used by this principal with a different execution descriptor.

ExecutionExpired.description: The execution existed for this principal, but its transient response data is no longer available.

SequenceNotSatisfiable.description: The requested frame sequence is outside the cached response stream.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request exceeds a configured metadata, body, or cache limit.

UnprocessableContent.description: The streamed body does not match declared length or digest metadata.

TooManyRequests.description: The authenticated principal has exceeded a configured execution or transfer limit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before another attempt should be made.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The proxy cannot accept another execution.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before another attempt should be made.

componentVersion.description: Version of the running proxy implementation.

TransportMetadataCapabilities.description: Transport observations available to the authenticated principal. A true value indicates implementation and policy support; an observation may still be absent when a particular connection fails before the value is known.

ExecutionId.description: Opaque execution identifier. Clients must not infer ownership or other semantics from its value.

method.description: Final HTTP method token to send to the target.

url.description: Final semantic absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL, including the already-materialized path and query string. The proxy must not independently add, remove, or reorder query parameters. The Host header and TLS server name are derived from this URL. URI fragments and user information are not permitted.

headers.description: Ordered final target header fields. Duplicate names are permitted. Header names are compared case-insensitively against the forbidden list.

value.description: Unmodified semantic header value. Control characters prohibited by HTTP/1.1 are not permitted.

length.description: Exact raw body length when known, otherwise null. Must be zero when mode is none. The proxy derives Content-Length from a known value and otherwise selects HTTP/1.1 streaming transfer framing.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the complete raw body when known, otherwise null. Must be null when mode is none. Because the proxy streams to the target, a mismatch can be detected only after some or all bytes have reached the target.

responseIdleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time between bytes received from the target after its response begins.

totalTimeoutMs.description: Maximum lifetime from execution creation through target completion. Starting at creation also bounds sessions that never begin request-body upload.

redirectMode.description: Redirect responses are returned to the backend and are never followed automatically in the MVP.

tlsVerification.description: Strict verifies the target certificate and hostname. Insecure explicitly disables enforcement of both checks for this execution while retaining TLS encryption. The proxy reports the verification outcome in transport metadata when its transport implementation exposes it.

maxResponseBodyBytes.description: Maximum target response body accepted for this execution. It must not exceed the effective principal capability.

ExecutionBehavior.description: Non-header target behavior. Outbound HTTP is HTTP/1.1, cookies are not retained between executions, and content encoding is never automatically decompressed. Transfer coding may be removed by HTTP framing while content-encoded bytes remain unchanged.

expiresAt.description: Null while the execution is active. After a terminal state, the time at which the proxy may delete transient state, cached frames, and the idempotency-key mapping.

error.description: Safe terminal failure details. Null unless state is failed.

ExecutionSession.description: Transient execution state. Principal identity is intentionally omitted because ownership is derived from authentication and is not client-controlled.
x-apinteract-state-rules: A bodyless execution becomes active when it is created.
A streaming-body execution becomes active when request-body upload begins.
Request upload and target response streaming may overlap.
Completed, failed, cancelled, and expired are terminal states.
Only terminal executions may be released.
Cancellation is best effort and cannot retract bytes already sent to the target.

ProxyResponseStream.description: Version 1 APInteract framed response stream. Each frame starts with the 16-byte header defined by the media type's x-apinteract-framing contract, followed by exactly payloadLength bytes.

httpVersion.description: HTTP transport version negotiated with the target.

receivedAt.description: Time at which the proxy received the final target response headers.

ResponseHead.description: Target response metadata. Transport observations are emitted here before response body frames when they are available.

bodySha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the complete raw response body when calculated.

ExecutionTimings.description: Target execution timings measured by the proxy. Optional phases are omitted when they do not apply or cannot be measured.

connectionReused.description: Whether the target connection existed before this execution.

TransportObservation.description: Best available observations about the target transport connection. Fields are omitted when they do not apply, are unavailable from the transport implementation, are suppressed by proxy policy, or were not observed before failure.

NetworkEndpoint.description: Observed socket endpoint. The remote endpoint is the address actually connected after name resolution, not the target hostname.

authorized.description: Whether the observed peer certificate and hostname satisfied normal strict verification, including when insecure mode allowed the connection to continue.

alpnProtocol.description: Negotiated ALPN protocol, or null when the peer did not negotiate ALPN.

serverName.description: TLS Server Name Indication value sent to the target, or null when no server name was sent.

peerCertificateChain.description: Peer certificate chain in leaf-first order as exposed by the transport runtime. A self-signed peer normally produces one entry.

TlsObservation.description: TLS observations collected during connection establishment. On a failed handshake, only values observed before failure are present.

TlsAuthorizationErrorCode.description: Normalized primary reason that normal strict certificate or hostname verification did not authorize the peer.

name.description: Cipher suite name reported by the transport runtime.

standardName.description: IANA cipher suite name when the transport runtime provides it.

derBase64.description: Base64 representation of the exact DER certificate bytes exposed by the transport runtime.

sha256Fingerprint.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the DER certificate bytes.

category.description: Origin of the execution failure. Valid target HTTP status responses, including 4xx and 5xx, are not errors.

code.description: Stable snake_case machine-readable error code. Clients must tolerate codes added in compatible API revisions.

message.description: Safe human-readable message that does not expose secrets or internal stack traces.

transport.description: Transport observations available before failure. When a response head was already emitted, the backend retains the observations from that frame and this field may be omitted.

ExecutionStreamError.description: Terminal execution failure. Valid target HTTP status responses, including 4xx and 5xx, are not failures.

HeaderList.description: Ordered HTTP header fields. Duplicate names are preserved.

traceId.description: Opaque identifier suitable for correlating sanitized proxy logs.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a stable APInteract error code. Extension members are permitted.
